structural_change: LH-SMATT/XS variant B after rg2 terminal clock FAIL (boundary 149.5/136.4 ps over a 432x345.6 outline at 28% fill): COMPACT rebuild. The 4-slot ring moves to 7 x ot_sram_1r1w_32x128_m1 (7,483 um2 vs 15,553: OT_SMH_XSRING32), the 4 x-store macros form one abutted N-S stack (pins W/E only), the ring sits in two 43.2-pitch columns between the W face (rl1 landing) and the N face (o_iw), outline 388.8x216 (-44% area, fill 43.5%, aspect 1.8). Macro-local KEPT posedge ring read/write address captures (OT_SMH_RING_LOCAL_ADDR/WADDR) replace the shared negedge address flops (rg2 TT -80 ps); own ring reset relay (OT_SMH_RING_RST2). 0 added data/startup edges. Clock: one centre-fed CTS root from the N-face centre pin (no custom tree) over the compact outline.

reroute_reason.why: closed r3 routed native audit FAIL (committed receipt results/arch/hf5_1018/native/native_3_audit.json, record smh_xs_ref_p45m-r3-29a3f8638): TT/FF pin-flop spread 106.4/101.9 > 80 (clock rule 0dq), capture 221.4 > 190 (98 pins), launch 254.5 > 220 (4 pins); the view cannot bind into the die. RTL change 81d8cf4b9 (ot_hbm_accel_smh.sv: OT_SMH_XSE E-face control copy as its own kept register; verified by CLOSED_STANDS); the kit also puts o_iw/o_ix on the N face (closed LEF had them on N/W/S/E), so native_spread (same faces) does not apply. Then hf5bt (smh_xs_ref_p45m-hf5bt-e1b14e06f) fixed the spread (gate 68.9/59.4) but ended NEEDS_RTL FF -45.75 on CTS-tree -> boundary-tree zero-logic hops (hold ECO rc=9).
reroute_reason.fix: compact 32x128 ring + abutted x-store stack (388.8x216), single centre-fed CTS root, macro-local ring addresses, own ring reset relay.
